messages:
Priya M: Hey finance — need quick approval for a one-off SMB promo for Spring. Customer 'Arcadia Apps' onboarding stalled; they're asking for 30% off hosted API for first 3 months + $5k onboarding credit. If we decline they’ll likely churn. Details below.

Samir (Finance): Quick q — what's the expected post-promo spend / ARR if they convert?

Priya M: Expected run-rate after promo ~ $8k/mo -> ~ $96k ARR if retained beyond promo. Proposal: 30% off for 3 months, one-time $5k onboarding credit, require 12mo commitment.

Evan R: Can we put a hard usage cap to avoid runaway token spend? Also need SOW/MSA in place before credit applied.

Priya M: Yes — propose token cap 200M tokens/month and billing alerts at 60/80/95%. Legal to sign SOW; sales has verbal agreement.

Deal Desk Bot: Policy check: discounts >25% require head-of-finance signoff or GC approval. See: https://redwood.internal/policies/discounts

Samir (Finance): Need a quick P&L. Put numbers here: 
```
Baseline revenue (3mo): $24,000
Discounted revenue (3mo): $16,800
One-time credit: $5,000
Estimated gross delta (3mo): -$12,200
Upside ARR if retained: +$96,000/yr
```

Priya M: We only apply credit if they sign 12mo commitment + auto-renew clause. Sales agrees.

Lina (CS): Confirmed customer verbally committed to 12mo. Will collect signed SOW and hand to legal.

Samir (Finance): Given churn risk and long-term upside, I approve: 30% off for first 3 months + $5k onboarding credit, conditional on: signed 12mo MSA, token cap 200M/mo, billing alerts enabled. @Legal please prioritize SOW review. :white_check_mark:

Priya M: Thanks Samir — will update the deal in Salesforce, set billing caps, and attach signed SOW once in. Will mark for deferred recognition per finance instructions. :thumbsup:
